title: Guidelines
slide_intent: Help readers find a particular design decision without reading the guide in sequence. Grouping ideas separately from templates makes the next page easier to choose.
strategic_value: The lab can serve both readers learning its identity and staff looking for a ready-to-use format through one index.
demonstration: Two columns group numbered page entries under Our Branding, Basic Elements, Templates and Contact Us. An angular rust tab carries the vertical Guidelines label.
practical_value: Use the index to find a rule, such as minimum logo size, or a deliverable, such as a research poster.

content_islands.name: Topic index
content_islands.spec: List page numbers and names down two columns. Keep each number aligned with its entry and use section headings to distinguish the groups.

content_islands.name: Section tab
content_islands.spec: Set Guidelines vertically in white on an angled rust-colored tab entering from the right edge.

content_islands.name: Publication footer
content_islands.spec: Align the guide title, descriptor and page number along the bottom.
